samplingFinding: Sixteen of twenty unseen query pages on ten previously qualified training domains passed the frozen capture gates, an 80% page yield. The four rejected attempts were one blocked annotation and three navigation timeouts.
visualValidationFinding: All sixteen accepted full-page annotation views were inspected after capture and showed coherent query-result evidence. The set includes explicit per-yard and per-square-foot prices, count-versus-dimension ambiguity, package kits, lazy-image abstentions, and adjacent-result hard negatives. Rope and Cord polyester exposed all twelve frozen roots in the annotation view while only one optional per-card crop completed; the required full-page evidence remained intact.
